messages.subject: error in plm fitting
parts:
Hi,
I am running a plm fitting of ExonRmaPlm(...,mergeGroups=FALSE) that was
interrupted previously. It's being run in BATCH mode, so I was looking
at the output as it goes along and I see this error in the midst of the
processing:

Fitting probe-level model...done
used (Mb) gc trigger (Mb) max used (Mb)
Ncells 1371147 73.3 2251281 120.3 2251281 120.3
Vcells 10043983 76.7 31488280 240.3 31488171 240.3
Storing probe-affinity estimates...
Updating units...
Encoding units...
Encoding units...done
Updating units...done
Storing probe-affinity estimates...done
Storing chip-effect estimates...
<simpleError in if (regexpr(pattern, header$identifier) == -1) {
throw("Rcache file format error. Invalid identi
fier: ", file)}: argument is of length zero>
Updating 132 chip-effect files...
Array #1 of 132 ('0124')...
Array #1 of 132 ('0124')...done

Should I be worried about this? The program didn't stop and seems to be
going along its merry way. But I'd rather stop it, destroy the previous
results from the stopped session, and start fresh than have question
mark results...

Thanks,
Elizabeth

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] error in plm fitting
parts:
On Thu, Feb 14, 2008 at 11:49 AM, Elizabeth Purdom <epu...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hi,
> I am running a plm fitting of ExonRmaPlm(...,mergeGroups=FALSE) that was
> interrupted previously. It's being run in BATCH mode, so I was looking
> at the output as it goes along and I see this error in the midst of the
> processing:
>
> Fitting probe-level model...done
> used (Mb) gc trigger (Mb) max used (Mb)
> Ncells 1371147 73.3 2251281 120.3 2251281 120.3
> Vcells 10043983 76.7 31488280 240.3 31488171 240.3
> Storing probe-affinity estimates...
> Updating units...
> Encoding units...
> Encoding units...done
> Updating units...done
> Storing probe-affinity estimates...done
> Storing chip-effect estimates...
> <simpleError in if (regexpr(pattern, header$identifier) == -1) {
> throw("Rcache file format error. Invalid identi
> fier: ", file)}: argument is of length zero>

You've spotted a typo/bug in R.cache. The error is trying to us a
connection object ('file') instead of the 'header$identifier'. Next
release of R.cache will have this fixed. However, this does not
explain why R.cache tries to throw an exception in the first place.
Read on...

> Updating 132 chip-effect files...
> Array #1 of 132 ('0124')...
> Array #1 of 132 ('0124')...done
>
> Should I be worried about this? The program didn't stop and seems to be
> going along its merry way. But I'd rather stop it, destroy the previous
> results from the stopped session, and start fresh than have question
> mark results...

According to the above, the internal file identifier is not valid.
This could occur if the file exists but is not completely written, or
there is a racing problem in the OS's write/read cache (not R.cache),
a racing problem in a shared file system on a LAN (but that is less
likely?!?).

However, since the above occurred for an Rcache file object, I
wouldn't worry at all. If aroma.affymetrix fails to read from file
cache, then it is the same as if it wasn't in the file cache and the
package will regenerate the data.

/Henrik

>
> Thanks,
> Elizabeth
